rule.A1: best-lr arm reaches f>=0.5 of oracle on >=2/3 records -> H-A (budget-bound)
rule.A2: all model arms f<0.25 everywhere while direct arm f>=0.5 -> H-B (feature head)
rule.A3: direct arm also f<0.5 and saturation>0.10 -> H-B (tanh-scale parameterization)
rule.A4: otherwise report per record, no single verdict
